column1: # tools/mkgame.py builds ONLY what is listed here. Anything else in Tuxemon (a
# tileset, a creature's sprite, a character sheet) is left out of game.bin.
# A map cell drawn from an unlisted tileset loses that layer's tile, and the
# build reports how many cells lost one.
# Columns: kind, slug, licence, authors, source, status
#   slug     the tileset's name in Tiled, the creature's slug, or the sheet's
#   status   credited:   the licence and authors are taken from Tuxemon's
#            unverified: no entry found yet; used in G0 spikes only (G3's
#            confirmed:  checked by hand against the source link (G3)
#            ours:       drawn for this project, CC0, at tools/game_art/<slug>.png
# Left out on purpose (section 10): anything under the "XYG Open Source
# License" (Kelvin Shadewing's sets, and core_buildings, core_set pieces,
# core_indoor_walls and core_indoor_floors, which ATTRIBUTIONS.md says are
# built partly from them); LimeZu's purchased sets; anything non-commercial.
